message.content: {"appearance_facts": [{"location": "Right side of the map", "fact": "A vertical color legend bar is present, with a light yellow top end and a dark red bottom end."}, {"location": "Legend scale", "fact": "The top of the legend is marked with the number 100, and the bottom is marked with 0."}, {"location": "Legend labels", "fact": "The word 'High' is printed next to the top of the legend bar, and 'Low' is printed next to the bottom."}, {"location": "Northeastern US", "fact": "The region labeled PA is filled with a very dark, deep red color."}, {"location": "Central US", "fact": "The region labeled NE is filled with a very dark, deep red color, appearing identical in shade to PA."}, {"location": "Northeastern US", "fact": "The region labeled NJ is filled with a light yellow color, similar to the top of the legend scale."}, {"location": "Northeastern US", "fact": "The region labeled DE is filled with a light yellow color, similar to the top of the legend scale."}, {"location": "Central US", "fact": "The region labeled MO is filled with a dark red color, but it is visibly lighter than the dark red of PA and NE."}], "printed_facts": [{"location": "Top left", "fact": "The title reads 'Prevalence of Species Z in US States'."}, {"location": "Legend", "fact": "The legend axis is labeled with 'High' at the top (100) and 'Low' at the bottom (0)."}, {"location": "Map", "fact": "State abbreviations are printed within their respective borders, including PA, NJ, DE, NE, MO, and WI."}, {"location": "Map", "fact": "Several states in the West and Midwest (e.g., CA, AZ, CO, AR, AL) are colored gray."}], "public_definitions": [], "uncertain": []}
